title: Glimmer's Little Light
markdown:
In a meadow where moonbeams loved to play, lived a little lantern. He was very new, and his light was just a tiny flicker. He sat quietly, a little shy, watching the sleepy sky. Dew gathered on his glass like tiny moons of their own. A moth circled once and did not stay, as if it was waiting for a brighter invitation.

One gentle evening, Rory the raccoon walked by. Rory had soft fur and happy ears. His fluffy tail twitched with joy. He saw the little lantern sitting in a nest of clover. “Hello, little lantern,” Rory whispered. His voice was soft, like warm milk. “Why is your light so small tonight?”

The lantern’s name was Glimmer. His little glass body shook just a tiny bit. “Oh, Rory,” Glimmer whispered. “My light is just a tiny flicker. I wish it could be a little bit brighter, like the friendly fireflies. I feel a little sad.” The fireflies were already out, stitching gold along the tall grass. Glimmer watched them and thought his own glow looked like a leftover crumb.

Just then, Puddle the pond pixie floated near. Her wings were shiny, like a dragonfly’s after rain. Puddle loved to hum happy songs, like tiny bells. “Sad feelings?” Puddle chirped, landing on a soft dewdrop. “We can help with sad feelings.” She hummed a note that made the dewdrop tremble, not from worry, from listening.

Rory nudged Glimmer with his soft nose. It was a warm touch. “We think your light is nice, Glimmer,” Rory said softly. “Little lights make the meadow feel warm and safe, like a cozy nest.” A sleepy flower leaned toward that idea as if it already believed it.

Puddle hummed her sweetest song, like gentle whispers. “Imagine your light,” Puddle said, “like a warm hug for the fireflies. Or a friendly wink for the sleepy flowers.”

Glimmer thought about warm hugs. He pictured his light being like a soft hug. He pictured it being like a friendly wink. He took a tiny breath. Rory and Puddle watched him with kind eyes. The moth came back and sat on his rim, as if it had decided the invitation was enough.

Then a little warm glow started to bloom inside Glimmer. It was a soft happy glow, not a shout, a lantern-sized yes. Glimmer looked at his light. It was just right. “Oh,” Glimmer whispered. “My light is here.”

Rory smiled his gentle smile. “You found your light, Glimmer,” he said softly.

Puddle hummed a soft sleepy tune. The meadow was bathed in Glimmer’s soft warm glow. It made everything feel calm and sleepy. A firefly hovered, borrowed the glow for a moment, and went on. Rory yawned a big quiet yawn. Puddle blinked her shiny wings. Glimmer’s soft light made everyone feel sleepy. Soon Glimmer drifted off to sweet peaceful dreams, his gentle light glowing softly, a wink the flowers could keep.
